name: Ellen Falk
subtitle: A life with room for others
intro: She knew the long way home, how to make soup for one more person, and when a thing was worth mending.
description: A fictional life on the Danish coast, remembered through ordinary things: walks, a kitchen table, a basket of repairs, and a garden that never quite followed the plan.
heroAlt: Wind-shaped pale dunes and a broad sandy beach beneath large clouds at Hvide Sande
heroCaption: An illustrative coastal photograph. All people and memories in this collection are fictional.
quote: We have time. Take the long way.
quoteAttribution: A favourite saying in Ellen’s fictional story
